tei:div.tei:p: "$ ༄༅// gdams ngag nyams len par mkho ba zab khrid mtha' dag gi sngon 'gro'i ngag 'don gyi rim par dmigs khrid don 'grel nyung ngur bkod pa mchog gi byin rlabs 'dren pa'i shing rta zhes bya ba bzhugs//

mi 'gyur bde ba'i ye shes cha rdzogs shing*// chos kun mkhyen gzigs snang ba mkha' mnyam can// mchog gi 'dod 'jo srid zhir phul byung ba'i// rje btsun bla mas bdag la bde legs mdzod// kun khyab spros bral chos dbyings gzhi// rang byung lhan skyes sgom pa'i lam// gdod ma'i gzhir grol 'bras bu ste// dbyer med phyag rgya chen por 'dud// gang gis chos kun mtha' bral bar// mnyam bzhag de bzhin nyid gzigs pas// gcig shes kun la mkhas pa yi// dkar brgyud rin chen de la 'dud// zab rgyas snying po'i don rgya mtsho// thugs su chud de bstan pa'i chu// spro zhing bsdu ba'i mkhas pa'i dbang*// dkar brgyud rin chen de la 'dud// bcos ma'i 'ching ba kun zhig cing*// rang bzhin dbyings su rtag dgyes pa// e waṃ sdom pa che grub pa'i// dkar brgyud rin chen de la 'dud// de dag rnams kyi zhal lung las// 'ongs pa'i phyag chen khrid rim gyi// sngon 'gro'i ngag 'don dmigs pa rnams// mang nyung 'tshams pa'i yi ge bri// 'dir phyag rgya chen po'i khrid rim sogs kyi sngon 'gro'i ngag 'don tshig ris dmigs par sgril ba la sngon 'gro bzhi sbyor so so'i thad la go don rgya che'i rigs rtsa brgyud bla ma'i gsung gsang dang khyad par skyabs rje 'jam dpal dpa' bos mdzad pa'i phyag chen khrid 'grel las rtogs dgos kyang thor bu 'gag don nyung ngu re blo rmongs pa 'ga' la phan phyir bri ba la de yang thun mong gi sngon 'gro dang thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro gnyis las/ thun mong la dal 'byor rnyed dka' bsam pa/ 'chi ba mi rtag pa bsam pa/ las rgyu 'bras 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs bsam pa rnams rgyud la go don thebs nges gal che bas 'dir 'don bya dang de'i go don nyung ngu re sbrags te bshad na/ dang por/ dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma rin po che// bdag gi snying gar pad+ma'i ze'u 'bru la// 'bral ba med par rtag par bzhugs nas kyang*// sku gsung thugs kyi byin gyis rlabs tu gsol// dal 'byor 'di ni rnyed par shin tu dka'// skyes bus don grub thob par gyur pa la// gal te 'di la phan pa ma bsgrub na// phyis 'di yang dag 'byor ba ga la 'gyur// ces brjod cing don bsam par de yang rang gi spyi bor rtsa ba'i bla ma lam gyis gsal btab cing mos gdung gis gsol ba btab la/

rang re rnams mi khom pa brgyad las ldog te/ dal ba brgyad dang 'byor pa bcu dang ldan pa'i mi lus te/ dam chos sgrub rung gi rten 'di shin tu rnyed par dka' yang da res sngon gyi dge ba'i mthus 'phangs pas skyes bu ste/ byang chub sgrub pa'i stobs dang ldan pa don grub pa thob par gyur pa'i skabs 'dir 'bad pa chen pos thar pa don du gnyer dgos la/ gal te chos nyams len ma byas par 'chi bar gyur na dal 'byor stong log byas pa ste/ phyis nas dal 'byor rten 'di lta bu thob pa ches dka' ste las dbang du 'gro ba'i phyir/ las ma byas pa dang mi 'phrad/ byas pa chud mi za ba yin ces gsung rab las 'byung bas/ ngan song du skyes na bde 'gro'i sgra yang thos par mi 'gyur ro// de bas da res dal 'byor rten thob pa 'di/ kha rje che bas chos snying nas byed dgos bsam mo// de nas dal 'byor rnyed dka' bsam pa ste dal 'byor 'di ni sogs spyod 'jug gi tshig yin no// 'chi ba mi rtag pa bsam pa ni/ srid gsum mi rtag ston ka'i sprin dang 'dra// 'gro ba'i skye 'chi gar la lta dang mtshungs// 'gro ba'i tshe 'gro nam mkha'i glog 'dra ste// ri gzar 'bab chu bzhin du myur 'gyogs 'gro// zhes rgya che rol pa'i tshig 'di'i don/ srid gsum thams cad ni mi rtag pa ston ka'i sprin dang gar mkhan gyi lag pa dang nam mkha'i glog dang ri gzar ngos kyi 'bab chu lta bur tshe 'di ni skad cig kyang mi gnas par 'chi ba'i lam du 'gro ba/ de la'ang rkyen nges pa med pas nam 'chi cha med pa ni/ bshes springs las/ tshe 'di gnod mang rlung gis btab pa yi// chu yi chu lbur bas kyang mi rtag na// ces gsungs pa ltar lags na dam pa'i chos long yod phyi gshol du mi 'jog par da lta nyid du brtson 'grus bskyed dgos snyam du bsam mo// las 'bras bsam pa ni/ dus kyis nyen te rgyal po 'gro gyur na// longs spyod 'dza' dang gnyen bshes rjes mi 'brang*// skyes bu dag ni gang dang gang 'gro ba// las ni grib ma bzhin du rjes su 'brang*// gsungs pa'i don las sdig pa dang dge ba'i dor len ma byas na tshe 'di'am shi ba'i 'og tu mi 'dod pa'i 'bras bu thog tu 'bab pas las gang zhig bar ma dor brlag par mi 'gyur bar ci zhig na dus la 'bab tshe myong bar 'gyur ba kho na yin pas/

mdo las/ lus can dag gi las rnams ni// bskal pa brgyar yang chud mi 'dza'// tshogs shing dus la babs pa na// 'bras bu nyid du smin par 'gyur// ces gsungs pa bzhin/ rang 'di nas phyi mar 'gro ba'i tshe zas gos longs spyod nye 'khor grogs sogs yid du 'ong ba'i phun sum tshogs pa ci yod kyang bzhag te 'gro dgos la/ las dge sdig gang byas kyi rnam smin ni lus dang grib ma bzhin du rjes su 'brang bas sdig pa'i las phra zhing phra ba nas spangs/ dge ba chung ngu yin na'ang che thang du 'bad dgos sdig pa mi dge ba phra rags mang yang rags pa gtso cher lus kyis srog gcod/ ma byin len/ 'dod pas log g.yem gsum/ ngag gis rdzun/ phra ma/ tshig rtsub/ ngag 'khyal te bzhi/ yid kyis brnab sems/ gnod sems/ log lta ste/ gsum bsdoms pas bcu po dang*/ mdor na 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug te// des bskyed las ni mi dge ba// zhes pa ltar dug gsum gyis bskyed pa'i las thams cad mi dge ba yin pas spang zhing de las ldog pa ni dge ba yin pas ci nus su bslab pa yin no// 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs bsam pa ni/ srid sred ma rig dbang gis skye bo rnams// mi dang lha dang ngan song rnam gsum po// 'gro ba lnga po dag tu mi mkhas 'khor// dper na rdza mkhan 'khor lo 'khor ba bzhin// srid gsum rga dang nad kyi sdug bsngal 'bar// 'di na 'chi me rab 'bar mgon med de// srid las byung la 'gro ba rtag tu rmongs// bum par chud pa'i bung ba 'khor ba bzhin// gal te rang cag nyon mongs pa'i las dbang las 'khor bar 'khor ba zhig na sdug bsngal 'ba' zhig las bde ba med cing*/ yun ring por bum nang gi bung ba sogs kyi dpes 'khor bzhin gnas pa ste/ mdo sde dran nyer/ sems can dmyal ba dmyal mes nyams// yi dwags bkres shing skom pas nyams// dud 'gro gcig la gcig zas nyams// mi dag 'tsho ba thung bas nyams// lha min mtha' cing rtsod pas nyams/

lha dag bag med pa yis nyams// 'khor ba khab kyi rtse tsam la// bde ba nam yang yod ma yin// zhes gsungs pas mtshon par nus bzhin dmyal ba la tsha dmyal brgyad/ grang dmyal brgyad de tsha grang gi sdug bsngal bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang yi dwags la bkres skom gyi sdug bsngal/ dud 'gro rnams la gcig la gcig za ba dang bkol spyod kyi sdug bsngal/ mi la skye rga na 'chi'i sdug bsngal/ lha la 'chi 'pho ltung byed kyi sdug bsngal sogs/ mdor na 'khor ba'i gnas gang sdug bsngal dngos su snang ba der ma zad/ bde ba snang ba tsam dang bar mar gnas pa'ang sdug bsngal nyid du lhung bas na 'khor ba 'di las thar pa'i thabs ci nus su 'bad par rigs pa ste/ slob dpon klu sgrub kyis/ 'khor ba de 'dra lags pas lha mi dang*// dmyal ba yi dwags dud 'gro rnams dag tu// skye ba bzang po ma lags skye ba ni// gnod pa du ma'i snod gyur lags mkhyen mdzod// ces gsungs pa ltar/ dus da res dam pa'i chos nyams su blangs te gtan du bde ba rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob pa'i thabs la ci nas brtson par bya ba ni gal po che yin no// ༈ thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro'i rim par/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed rdor sems bsgom bzlas/ maṇ+ḍal bla ma'i rnal 'byor te bzhi las dang po skyabs sems kyi khrid la/ skyabs yul gsal gdab pa'i 'don dmigs kyi rim pa ni 'di skad du/ rang mdun nam mkhar laṃ yig ser po las// gser gyi sa gzhi khod snyoms rgya che zhing*// khor yug ne'u sing bkod legs ljongs yid 'ong*// bde ldan zhing ltar phun sum tshogs pa'i dbus// baṃ yig dkar zhu bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho ni// rab dwangs yid sim rba rlabs dal bur g.yo// sprul pa'i bya tshogs snyan pa'i chos sgra sgrog /rin chen pad+mas brgyan pa'i dbus su ni// dgos 'dod kun 'byung dpag bsam ljon pa che// yal 'dab rab rgyas dri bsung phyogs bcur 'gro// de steng rin chen khri pad nyi zla'i steng*// rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang dbang sku// zhi 'dzum phyag gnyis rdor dril 'khyud rgyas 'dzin// snyan mgul phyag zhabs rin chen rgyan gyis mdzes// ral pa'i thor tshugs rin chen cod paṇa brgyan// mtshan dpe gsal rdzogs rdo rje'i skyil krung bzhugs// 'od dang 'od zer 'phreng ba 'khrigs pa yi// dbu thog nas yar brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams// mtha' skor rgya bod mkhas grub ji snyed pa// bsam gyis mi khyab khrom tshogs lta bur gsal// bla ma rdo rje 'chang gi mdun ngos su// pad nyi 'jigs byed dus mtshan bsgyel ba'i steng*// yi dam 'khor lo sdom pa zhal bzhi pa// bcu gnyis phyag ldan phag mo mnyam sbyor bar// rgyud sde bzhi yi lha tshogs rnams kyis bskor// g.yas su pad zla'i gdan steng bcom ldan 'das// shākya thub par dus gsum sangs rgyas kyis// yongs su bskor te bzhugs pa rnam par sgom// rgyab tu yum chen shes rab phar phyin ma// gser mdog zhal gcig phyag bzhi rdor skyil mdzes// mtha' skor gsung rab dam chos rnams kyis bskor// g.yon du snying rje'i dbang phyug spyan ras gzigs// dkar po phyag bzhi rgyan mdzes pad zlar bzhugs// byang sems nyan thos dge 'dun grangs med bskor// phyogs mtshams thams cad ye shes ḍā ki ni// dpal mgon lcam dral ye shes srung ma'i sde// mkha' dbyings gang bar bzhugs pa thams cad kyang*// gang 'dul sku yi rnam pa cir shar yang*// ngo bo rtsa ba'i bla ma'i ye shes 'phrul// bdag la dgyes bzhin byin gyis rlobs phyir bzhugs// bdag lus bkod pa grangs med sprul pa dang*// rigs drug sems can nam mkha' khyab pa kun// lus ngag yid gsum gus pas skyabs su mchi// 'gro kun 'khor ba'i 'jigs las skyabs tu gsol// zhes tshig don bsam bzhin brjod nas dngos su phyag bgyid par/

ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bla ma sangs rgyas chos kyi sku la skyabs su mchi'o// ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bla ma longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku la skyabs su mchi'o// ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bla ma thugs rje sprul pa'i sku la skyabs su mchi'o// ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bla ma sangs rgyas rin po che la skyabs su mchi'o// zhes brjod/ phyag 'bum gtong skabs thun rer phyag stong phrag re btsal dgos par bla ma sangs rgyas chos sku la phyag brgya phrag gcig bla ma longs sku la nyis brgya/ bla ma sprul sku la gsum brgya bla ma sangs rgyas rin po che la bzhi brgya bcas 'gro dgos/ de nas/ bdag sogs sems can thams cad kyi blo chos su 'gro bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol// zhes sogs kyi gsol ba gdab cing byin rlabs zhu ba ni/ de la blo chos su 'gro ba'i chos ni 'jig rten gyi lugs bzang po ste de spyad pas thar pa'i snod rung du 'gyur bas na 'jig rten pa'i theg pa'am skyes bu chung ngu'i lam dang*/ chos lam du 'gro bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol// zhes pa ni skyes bu 'bring gi nyams len te/ de sgom pas sdug bsngal spangs nas mya ngan las 'das par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro// lam 'khrul pa sel bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol// zhes pa ni skyes bu chen po'i nyams len rgyu'i theg chen te/ nyan rang gi lam gyis ni nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa 'joms kyi/ shes bya'i sgrib pa spong mi nus shing theg chen pas sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa'i 'khrul pa thams cad tsher ma 'byin pa bzhin du drung nas 'byin nus pas 'khrul pa sel ba'i tha snyad du 'jog 'khrul pa ye shes su 'char bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes pas ni skyes bu ches mchog gi nyams len 'bras bu sngags kyi theg chen ston te/ 'khrul pa dang ma 'khrul pa zhes spang gnyen gnyis su dbyer med par/

'khrul pa bdo tsa na de'i rang bzhin shes pas 'khrul med du gtan la phebs pas ye shes su shar ba ste/ des ni dwags po chos bzhi zhes pa'i khrid rkang du yang 'gyur ba dang phyag rgya chen po'i lam rim yang don rkang der gnas pas de rnams rim bzhin mngon rtogs rgyud la skye ba'i 'dod don gsol ba 'debs pa'o// rtsa ba'i bla ma brgyud pa dang bcas pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// mched grogs chos mdzad dang bcas pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// zhes pa rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma dang grogs dam tshig dang ldan pa'i rdo rje spun la skyabs 'gro bgyid pa phyi mos yul gyi skyabs 'gro/ snod kyi 'jig rten dpal ldan bla ma'i tshogs la skyabs su mchi'o// bcud kyi sems can lha dang lha mo'i tshogs la skyabs su mchi'o// ces pa bcud kyi sems can snod kyi 'jig rten la brten pa ltar/ yi dam lha tshogs thams cad kyang rtsa ba'i bla ma'i sgyu ma'i rnam rol du nges shing*/ yi dam mkha' 'gro'i dngos grub kyang bla ma'i byin rlabs la rag lus phyir bla ma rtsa gsum kun 'dus su shes pa nang dag snang gi skyabs 'gro/ mdor na snang srid thams cad bla ma'i rol pa de yang rang sems lhan cig skyes par ngo 'phrod cing gtan la phebs pa ni gsang ba don dam bla med kyi skyabs 'gro ste/ snang srid dpal ldan bla ma'i tshogs la skyabs su mchi'o// zhes pa yin no// rtogs pas bdag grol bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ thugs rjes gzhan grol bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ rten 'brel thabs la mkhas par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ 'brel tshad don dang ldan par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes pa go sla ba ste/ mdor na rang don du spangs rtogs mthar phyin gzhan don thugs rje rgyun chad med pas 'gro ba'i don spyod nus pa sogs/

mthar thug gi go 'phang phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub thob par smon pa'o// de nas skyabs sems rgyas pa'i tshul du blang ba ni/ phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i bla ma dang*/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' che/ dpa' bo dpa' mo rnal 'byor tshogs/ thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ zhes pa ni/ skyabs yul tshogs zhing gsal gdab kyis mtshon pa'i phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi rgyal ba sras bcas rtsa ba dang brgyud pa'i bla ma gang 'dul der ston gyi yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ zhes pa'o// deng nas brtsams te mgon med bdag /byang chub snying po ma thob bar// 'khor ba'i 'jigs pa chen po las// bdag dang 'gro rnams skyabs pa'i phyir// rkang gnyis gtso bo sku gsum bdag /bcom ldan 'das la skyabs su mchi// 'dod chags bral zhing mya ngan 'das// zhi ba'i chos la skyabs su mchi// tshogs kyi mchog gyur sa la bzhugs// phyir mi ldog la skyabs su mchi// zhes pa deng nas bzung ste bdag gzhan 'gro ba mgon med thams cad 'khor ba'i 'jigs pa chen po las bskyab tu gsol zhing de yang byang chub snying po ma thob kyi bar du skyabs bslu ba med pa rkang gnyis gtso bo sku gsum gyi bdag nyid sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la skyabs su mchi'o// zhi ba chags bral lha mis mchod 'os pa// zhes pa ltar/ 'dod chags dang bral zhing mya ngan las 'das pa nyid yin cing chags bral zhi ba'i ngo bo nyid des gzhan rgyud grol bar mdzad pa dam pa'i chos la skyabs su mchi snyam pa dang tshogs rnams kyi mchog theg pa che chung gi dge 'dun 'phags pa'i sa la bzhugs pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o snyam pa theg pa thun mong gi mchog gsum la skyabs su gsol ba ste/ skyabs yul la phyi nang gsang gsum du 'byed pa'i phyi'i skyabs yul dang nang gi skyabs yul du bzhag pa ni/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku// bla ma mchog la skyabs su mchi// dngos grub ster ba'i yi dam lha// dkyil 'khor lha la skyabs su mchi// dpa' bo dpa' mo rnal 'byor tshogs// mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la skyabs su mchi// zhes pa ste bla ma ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo nyid sku yin pas na rang bzhin gyi sku zhes bya/

dngos grub ster ba'i yi dam lha zhes par dbyibs kyi lha sngags sam yi ge'i lha ting nge 'dzin dang phyag rgya'i lha zhes phye bas chos dkon mchog 'dir 'du dpa' bo dang dpa' mo zung 'jug du tshogs pa'i phyir rnal 'byor ni/ nam mkhar kun tu rgyu grub pas/ mkha' 'gro ma zhes rab tu grags/ zhes gsungs pa ltar dbyings stong pa nyid kyi nam mkha' la mi 'gyur ba'i ye shes 'gro ba zung 'jug lhan skyes ston pa'i tshig dpa' bo dpa' mo zhes pa'i shugs las chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs kyang ston/ don byin rlabs zhu ba'i yul bla ma/ dngos grub zhu ba'i yul yi dam/ 'phrin las sgrub pa'i grogs mkha' 'gro chos skyong zhes rtsa ba gsum sngags kyi thun mong ma yin pa ste spyi khyab kyi dkon mchog gsum steng bsnan pas drug skor du gsungs pa dang de yang sangs rgyas la ston pa zhu des bstan pa'i chos nyams su blangs pas grol ba thob phyir chos la skyabs gnas kyi dngos gzhi dge 'dun la lam sgrub pa'i zla grogs zhu ba ste/ sngags su de thams cad bla ma nyid kyis mdzad pas/ bla ma sangs rgyas bla ma chos/ de bzhin bla ma dge 'dun ste/ bla ma dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang*/ zhes rgyud las gsungs pa ltar bla ma nyid rtsa gsum kun 'dus/ dkon mchog kun 'dus su shes par bya ba gnad do// gsang ba'i skyabs yul du bzhag pa/ stong nyid snying rje dbyer med pa'i// gnyug ma'i sems la skyabs su mchi// zhes pa gsal ba rnam pa kun ldan gyi stong pa dang zab pa mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba gnyis gdod nas lhan gcig skyes pa zung 'jug gi ye shes sems nyid gdod ma'i gnas lugs rtogs pa de'o// de ni/ dag thob bral ba'i sems sangs rgyas// mi 'gyur dri med chos dang ni// yon tan lhun rdzogs dge 'dun no// zhes pa dang mthun pa nyid do// bdag gi lus ngag yid gsum gyis// sngon chad sdig pa ci bgyis pa// mgon po khyed kyi spyan sngar bshags// phyin chad sdig las ldog par bgyi// deng nas khyed kyi 'bangs su mchi// khyed kyi brlab bya rjes su slob// khyed kyi bka' las mi 'da' bar// kun nas yongs su bskyab tu gsol// zhes gzhan don du rdzogs byang thob phyir mchog gsum la skyabs su gsol nas/

skyabs de dag gi 'bangs su zhugs phyin/ de mi dgyes pa spong dgos pas sdig pa spong dge ba sgrub pa sogs bslab bya rnams la slob cing*/ las mi dge bar sngar spyad rnams mthol bshags bgyid pa dang phyin chad sdig las ldog nas khyed kyi bka' las mi 'da' bar yi dam bzung ba ste go sla'o// skyabs 'gro'i bslab bya ni spyir dge ba kun la bslab pa yin mod/ bye brag sangs rgyas kyi sku gsung thugs rten la sangs rgyas dngos kyi 'du shes bzhag la gus pas bkur bsti bya/ sangs rgyas kyi sku gzugs la sogs pa mi bshig mi 'tshong mi 'gom sems can la gnod 'tshe spong dam pa'i chos mi spong chos dang chos smra ba la gus par bya chos nyan chos la so sor rtog thos shing rtogs pa'i chos rnams gzhan la ston/ rnam pa thams cad du dam pa'i chos bsrung ba la bslab grogs mu stegs sogs dang mi 'grogs de dag la mi bsten bkur bsti mi bya/ dge slong dge 'dun la gus pas bsnyen par bya ba dang*/ skyes bu dam pa la bsten pa/ dam pa'i chos nyan pa/ thos don yid la byed pa/ bden bzhi sgom pa/ dbang po mi rgod pa/ rgyun du dkon mchog mchod pa la brtson pa/ lus srog la babs kyang dkon mchog mi spong ba dang sngags thun mong min par rtsa gsum sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig la gus pas sbyor ba sogs so// skyabs yul dpang por bzhugs pa la sems bskyed len pa ni/ ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams// byang chub tu ni nges mdzad ltar// byang chub sems ni bla na med// dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi// zhes pa'i don ni ji ltar dus gsum byon pa'i rgyal ba sras bcas kun gyis rang gzhan don phun sum tshogs pa'i byang chub chen po'i slad du tshogs ma lus pa bsags pas nges par sgrub par mdzad pa ltar/ bla na med pa'i byang chub sems dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi'o// zhes pa ste/

smon pa'i sems bskyed dang 'jug pa sems bskyed ni/ tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang*// dge ba'i chos rnams sdud pa dang*// sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum// bdag gis brtan por bzung bar bgyi// zhes pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pa ni mi dge ba bcu la sogs pa nyes spyod sdom pa'i tshul khrims te byang chub kyi sems gnas pa'i rgyur gyur pa dang*/ phar phyin drug gam bcu sogs dge ba'i chos rnams sgrub par byed pa ni dge ba'i chos sdud kyi tshul khrims te/ bdag nyid kyi sangs rgyas chos rnams yongs su smin pa'i rgyur gyur pa dang*/ sems can don byed kyi tshul khrims ni/ snyan par smra ba mkho ba sbyin pa don mthun pa don spyod pa ste bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhis sems can la phan bde sgrub pa ste sems can yongs su smin pa'i rgyur gyur pa/ brtan por bzung ba ni/ phyir mi ldog par bzung ba'i don no// bla na med pa'i byang chub sems// dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi// sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// bdag gis sdom pa ma lus bzung*// zhes pa gong gi smon 'jug sems bskyed ni kun rdzob sems bskyed de/ kun rdzob ni dmigs bcas 'dir ni 'khor gsum dag pa don dam pa'i sems su la bzla pas sems bskyed pa kun gyi mthar thug yin pas bla na med pa dang dmigs pa med pas dam pa ste bdag gis bskyed par bgyi zhes pa ste gzhan go sla/ ma bsgral ba rnams bdag gis bsgral// ma grol ba rnams bdag gis dgrol// dbugs ma phyin par dbugs dbyung zhing*// sems can mya ngan 'das la 'god// zhes pa nyan rang sogs theg dman gyi sa las ma bsgral ba rnams byang chub chen po'i gnas su bsgral ba dang*/ tshangs pa la sogs nyon mongs pa'i 'ching ba las ma grol ba rnams nyon mongs med par dgrol ba dang*/ dmyal ba sogs ngan song gsum gyi sdug bsngal las dbugs ma phyin pa rnams dbugs dbyung zhing*/

mthar thug sems can thams cad mi gnas pa'i myang 'das rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu 'god par bya'o zhes pa yin no// 'dir lam rim gzhan du/ sems can ma bsgral ba ni ngan song gsum/ bsgral ba ni de dag ngan song gi sdug bsngal las sgrol te mngon mtho'i lam lha mi'i go 'phang thob par bya ba dang*/ ma grol ba ni lha dang mi'i 'gro ba rnams te nyon mongs kyi 'ching ba las bkrol te nges legs kyi lam la bkod cing thar pa'i go 'phang thob par bya ba dang dbugs ma phyin pa ni nyan rang rnams theg pa chen por dbugs ma phyin pa/ de rnams byang chub tu sems bskyed nas theg pa chen po'i lta spyod du dbugs dbyung te sa bcu'i go 'phang thob par bya ba dang byang chub sems dpa' yongs su mya ngan las ma 'das pa rnams mya ngan las 'das pa sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya ba// sogs su bshad de rnams grangs so// de ltar sems bskyed cho ga lan gsum blang*/ sems bskyed kyi bslab bya la rgyun du bslab ste/ smon sems mi nyams shing 'phel ba'i phyir/ sems can blos mi btang sems bskyed pa'i phan yon dran par bya/ tshogs gnyis 'grub tshad du bsag pa dang*/ byang sems la yang yang blo sbyang ba dang dkar po'i chos bzhi sgrub cing*/ nag po'i chos bzhi spong ba rnams so// 'jug sdom mi nyams shing 'phel ba'i phyir sdom pa'i tshul khrims dge ba chos sdud sems can don byed gsum la 'bad pa'o// sems bskyed blangs rjes tshogs zhing bsdu ba la/ skyabs yul bar rnams mdun gyi lha la thim// g.yas bskor tshul gyis rim pa 'dus pa ni// dbus kyi ris med bla ma de brgyud pa// de rnams yas mar 'od zhu bla mar 'dus// kun 'dus rtsa ba'i bla ma rigs kyi bdag /bdag la thim pas sku gsung thugs rdo rje// lus ngag yid dang rnam dbyer med pa'i gshis// rang rig ye shes don gyi skyabs 'gro mchog

/de yang mdun gyi yi dam rnams g.yas kyi sangs rgyas gtso 'khor la thim/ de yang rgyab kyi yum chen mo gsung rab dang bcas pa la thim/ de rnams g.yon gyi theg pa che chung gi dge 'dun gtso 'khor la thim/ de bla ma rdo rje 'chang la thim pa'am yang na phyogs kun nas 'od kyi rnam par bsdus te bla ma rdo rje 'chang la thim/ bla ma yang 'od phung gi rnam par rang nyid la thim pas bla ma rang sems dbyer med rtsa bral lhun grub chen po'i ngang du mnyam par bzhag go /sems can thams cad nyon mongs 'ching bas bcings/ 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal 'jigs pa chen pos mnar// de bas bdag gzhan thar pa mchog thob phyir// gtan skyabs bslu med dkon mchog gsum la bcol// rang nyid gcig pu thar 'dod sems bskyed dman// de bas 'gro kun don phyir byang sems bskyed// dam pa'i chos la nyams len mi zhan par// brtson pas sangs rgyas sgrubs mdzod skal ldan rnams// go zhing shes na skyabs sems tsam la yang*// chos kyi gnad kun 'dus so de yi phyir// lag tu len mdzod phan yon brjod las 'das// rang gzhan legs par 'dod rnams dgongs par 'tshal// zhes pa ni bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o// ༈ gnyis pa 'gal rkyen sdig sgrib sbyong bar byed pa rdor sems sgom bzlas ni/ rang gi spyi bor paṃ las pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa'i lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa de las 'od zer 'phros 'phags pa mchod sems can gyi don byas tshur 'dus hūm̐ la thim de yongs su gyur pa las dpal rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ yum rdo rje snyems ma dmar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/ gnyis ka'ang rus pa dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/

zhabs rdo rje skyil mo krung du bzhugs pa'i spyi bor oṃ mgrin par āḥthugs kar hūm̐/ hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum gyi rnam par spyan drangs hūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes 'don/ tshig don gzhan ni go sla la dzaḥ zhes pa'i skabs ye shes pa dbyings nas dgug hūm̐ zhes pas dam tshig pa'i spyi bor byon/ baṃ ces pas chu la chu bzhag pa ltar gnyis med du 'dres/ hoḥces pas dgyes shing brtan par bzhugs par bsam/ de ltar sa bon dang phyag mtshan sa bon gyis mtshan pa dang*/ sku yongs su rdzogs pa gsum ni rdo rje cho ga gsum bskyed dang phyi'i rdor sems dbyibs kyi lha/ sku rdo rje'i rnal 'byor ro// thugs ka'i cha smad tsam du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor steng rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa/ de'i lte bar thugs srog hūm̐ yig dkar po de'i mtha' bskor du gsung sngags yi ge brgya ba sngags 'phreng g.yon du bkod pa g.yas su 'khor ba la dmigs nas bzlas brjod gsol 'debs kyi tshul du byed pa ni nang gi rdor sems sngags kyi lha/ gsung rdo rje'i rnal 'byor ro// de nas bcom ldan 'das bdag dang mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ oṃ badz+ra satwa sa ma ya/ ma nu pā la ya/ badz+ra satwa twe no pa tiṣ+ṭha/ dṛ ḍho me bha wa/ su to ṣ+yo me bha wa/ su bo ṣ+yo me bha wa/ a nu rak+to me bha wa/ sarba sid+dhim+me pra yats+tsha/ sarba karma su tsa me tsit+taṃ/ shre yaḥku ru hūm̐/ ha ha ha ha hoḥ bha ga wan/ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra mā me muñtsa/ badz+rī bha wa ma hā sa ma ya satwa āḥ ces pa'i bod skad/ rdo rje sems dpa' dam tshig rjes su skyongs shig rdo rje sems dpa' khyod kyis nye bar bzhugs shig rdo rje sems dpa' khyod bdag la brtan par nye bar bzhugs par mdzod cig

bdag shin tu tshim par mdzod/ bdag shin tu rgyas par mdzod/ bdag la rjes su chags par mdzod/ dngos grub thams cad bdag la rab tu rtsol/ las thams cad la'ang bdag gi sems dge bar mdzod/ kye bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdo rje/ bdag ma 'dor/ rdo rje can du mdzod cig dam tshig sems dpa' chen po āḥ ces pa rnams yin no// de ltar gsol ba btab cing sngags 'don skabs/ rdor sems kyi thugs ka'i sa bon sngags 'phreng dang bcas pa las 'od zer 'phros/ sems can gyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ rgyal ba sras bcas mchod/ de dag gi byin mthu bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyi rnam par spyan drangs/ sku dang sa bon sngags 'phreng rnams la thim pas byin rlabs dang gzi byin mtshungs pa med pa sangs rgyas kun gyi sku gcig pur gyur par bsam/ de nas yab yum gnyis kyi sku'i cha shas las sku'i byin rlabs/ sngags 'phreng las gsung*/ zla ba rdo rje las thugs/ hūm̐ las ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgyun dkar la dwangs pa rgyun mi chad du sbyor mtshams nas babs/ rang gi spyi bor nas zhugs pas lus phyi nang med par bkrus shing thog med nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib nad gdon bgegs thams cad dud khu'am sol khu dang srog chags mi sdug pa'i rnam par/ dbang po'i sgo dang ba spu'i bu ga kun nas nag nyil gyis thon/ rang lus shel dag pa'i snod 'o mas gang ba ltar dri ma med pa'i byang sems kyis gang bar bsam pa ni/ gsang ba'i rdor sems gong bu'i lha thugs rdo rje rnal 'byor ro// de ltar dmigs pa la gnad du bsnun zhing yig brgya gang mang bzla/ skabs su mkha' mnyam gyi sems can re re'i spyi bor rdor sems yab yum re re spros nas sdig sgrib 'khrud pa'i mos pa'am/ rang gi spyi bor sgom pa'i rdor sems kyi sbyor mtshams nas bdud rtsi'i rgyun sems can ma lus pa'i spyi bo nas zhugs pa sogs gang rung sgom gsung*/

mthar/ mgon po bdag ni mi shes rmongs pa yis/ dam tshig las ni 'gal zhing nyams/ bla ma mgon pos skyabs mdzod cig /gtso bo rdo rje 'dzin pa ste// thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid can// 'gro ba'i gtso la bdag skyabs mchi// sku gsung thugs rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig nyams pa thams cad 'thol lo bshags so// sdig sgrib nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas rdo rje sems dpa'i zhal nas rigs kyi bu khyod kyi nyes ltung thams cad dag pa yin no// zhes gnang ba sbyin nas rang la gnyis su med par thim par gyur/ zhes mos shing mnyam par bzhag pa ni don dam de kho na nyid kyi rdor sems ye shes rdo rje'i rnal 'byor ro// de ltar rdor sems sgom bzlas la nan tan gyis 'bad dgos te/ sdig sgrib ma dag na byin rlabs mi 'jug byin rlabs mi 'jug na lam gyi yon tan rgyud la mi skye shing spyir las mi dge ba thams cad kyis ngan song gi sdug bsngal mi bzod pa'i gnas su 'phen zhing de las kyang sdom gsum dang 'gal ba'i nyes pa lci/ khyad par gsang sngags kyi dam tshig dang 'gal ba'i nyes pa ni ches che bas/ gnong 'gyod drag pos bshags sdom dang sdig pa sbyong ba'i thabs la myur por 'bad dgos shing*/ spyod 'jug las/ bdag ni sdig pa ma byang ba'i// sngon du 'gum par 'gyur tu mchi// ji ltar 'di las nges thar bar// myur ba'i tshul gyis skyabs tu gsol// zhes pa bzhin dang snying po rgyan las/ yi ge brgya pa cho ga bzhin/ nyi shu rtsa ni re re bzla/ ltung sogs byin gyis rlabs 'gyur bas// 'phel ba ru ni mi 'gyur zhes// grub pa mchog rnams kyis bshad pas// thun mtshams ni spyad par bya// 'bum phrag du ni bzlas gyur na// rnam par dag pa'i bdag nyid 'gyur// zhes gsungs pas tshegs chung don che ba'i gdams pa la 'bad par bya'o// sgo gsum sdig pa'i bag chags kyis bsgos par// dkar po'i yon tan 'phel ba'i sa bon ci// bla med bde chen go 'phang sgrub 'dod na// bla ma rdo rje sems dpa'i sgrub thabs long*// ces kyang smras so//

༈ gsum pa tshogs rdzogs par byed pa maṇ+ḍal gyi sgom don ni/ sgrub pa'i maṇ+ḍal dang mchod pa'i maṇ+ḍal dang gnyis las sgrub pa'i maṇ+ḍal ni dkon mchog gi rten dngos su yod pa'am/ gang na yang dmigs pa'i rim pa tshogs zhing gsal gdab pa ni/ rang gi mdun mkhar rin chen sna bzhi las// yongs grub ri rab gru bzhi bang rim bzhis// mdzes pa rgya khyon tshad med dpangs mtho ba'i// steng du sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab bzhi pa// lhun po'i kha khyab de yi lte ba ru// mi 'jigs bzhi ldan seng ges bteg pa'i khri// pad nyi zla ba'i gdan steng 'khor lo'i mgon// bla ma rdo rje 'chang dbang zung 'jug skur// brgyud pa'i bla ma'i tshogs kyis bskor bar bsam// mdun gyi 'dab mar stobs bcu dang ldan pa'i// glang chen khri steng pad nyi'i gdan bzhugs pa'i// yi dam 'khor lo sdom pa gtso bo la// rgyud sde bzhi yi yi dam lha tshogs gsal// g.yas kyi 'dab mar rdzu 'phrul rkang pa bzhi// mtshon byed rta yis bteg pa'i rin chen khri// pad zla'i gdan la bde gshegs shākya'i tog /dus gsum rgyal ba rnams kyis bskor te bzhugs// rgyab kyi 'dab mar dbang bcu mnga' ba yi// rma byas bteg pa'i khri dang pad zla la// shes rab phar phyin yum mchog dam pa'i chos// glegs bam rnam pas bskor te bzhugs par mos// g.yon gyi 'dab mar thogs med thugs rje'i stobs// shugs 'chang mkha' lding gis bteg rin chen khri// pad zla'i gdan la 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs// byang sems dge 'dun chen po'i 'khor gyis bskor// gzhan yang phyogs mtshams steng 'og thams cad du// dpa' bo dpa' mo ye shes srung ma'i sde// dmigs med thugs rje'i bdag nyid mchod 'os kun// bdag la dgyes bzhin byin gyis rlobs phyir bzhugs// zhes ngag tu brjod cing don bsam nas/ mchod pa'i maṇ+ḍal gyi thog mar bzang spyod nas byung ba'i ji snyed su dag ma 'don bzhin phyag 'tshal te/

de yang*/ ji snyed su dag phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten na// dus gsum gshegs pa mi yi seng ge kun// bdag gis ma lus de dag thams cad la// lus dang ngag yid dang bas phyag bgyi'o// zhes pa'i don phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten ji snyed na su dag ces/ 'jig rten gyi khams gcig gi bcu la sogs pa'i grangs tshad can ma yin par/ phyogs bcu mtha' yas pa na bzhugs pa la phyag 'tshal te/ de yang da ltar bzhugs pa ma zad kyi/ dus gsum du gshegs shing bzhugs pa mir skye ba ston pa dang*/ thams cad la 'jigs pa dang*/ bral ba'i mi yi seng ge te sangs rgyas ma lus pa de dag thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo// su zhig gis phyag 'tshal ce na bdag gis so// tshul ji ltar phyag 'tshal na/ lus dang ngag yid dang ba ste rnyog pa dang bral ba'i dad pa chen po'i sgo nas phyag bgyi'o// ces pa ste sgo gsum gcig tu 'dus pa'i phyag go /sgo gsum so so'i phyag las thog mar lus kyi phyag ni/ bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam stobs dag gis// rgyal ba thams cad yid kyis mngon sum du// zhing gi rdul snyed lus rab btud pa yis// rgyal ba kun la rab tu phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pa'i don bzang po spyod pa la smon cing 'dun pa ste smon lam gyi stobs dag gis/ sdig pa'i chos thams cad las rgyal bas rgyal ba ste/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba ma lus pa thams cad yid kyi mos pas mngon sum du dmigs te/ de re re'i sku mdun du yang sangs rgyas kyi zhing ma lus pa dag gi rdul ji snyed pa dang grangs mnyam pa'i lus rab tu btud pas rtag tu phyag 'tshal lo// zhes so// yid kyi phyag ni/ rdul gcig steng na rdul snyed sangs rgyas rnams// sangs rgyas sras kyi dbus na bzhugs pa dag /de ltar chos kyi dbyings rnams ma lus pa// thams cad rgyal ba dag gis gang bar mos// rdul phra rab gcig gi steng ste go sa na yang zhing ma lus pa'i rdul gyi grangs ji snyed pa'i grangs dang mnyam pa'i sangs rgyas bzhugs pa dang de yang gcer ba dang dog pa ma yin par sangs rgyas sras byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor gyis bskor te bzhugs pa dang de yang rdul gcig gi steng na de ltar yod pa bzhin du yul phyogs 'jig rten gyi khams gcig tsam du ma zad chos kyi dbyings ma lus pa ste chos dbyings kyis gar khyab nam mkhas khyab/

nam mkhas gar khyab de dang mnyam pa'i zhing rab 'byams thams cad rgyal ba sras bcas kyis gang bar mos shing yid kyis dad pa bla na med pa sgom mo// ngag gi phyag ni/ de dag bsngags pa mi zad rgya mtsho rnams// dbyangs kyi yan lag rgya mtsho'i sgra kun gyis// rgyal ba kun gyi yon tan rab brjod cing*// bde bar gshegs pa thams cad bdag gis bstod// ces pa/ chos kyi dbyings dang mnyam pa'i sangs rgyas de dag gi bsngags pa bskal pa'i bar du brjod kyang mi zad pa rgya mtsho lta bu rnams la/ bstod dbyangs yan lag lnga'am drug cu sogs rgya mtsho ltar mang ba'i sgra kun gyis rgyal ba'i yon tan rab tu brjod pa'i tshul gyis bde bar gshegs pa de dag thams cad bdag gis bstod do// de yang chos dbyings dang mnyam pa'i sangs rgyas re re drung du lus zhing gi rdul snyed du sprul pa dang lus de lta bus sangs rgyas re re'i zhabs la 'dud cing*/ lus re re la yang mgo de snyed dang*/ mgo re re la yang lce'i rtse mo de snyed dang*/ lce de snyed las kyang bstod dbyangs de snyed byung bar mos pa'o// ces kun mkhyen sgrol ba'i mgon pos gsungs la// de ltar phyag 'tshal ba'i yan lag sngon du song nas mchod pa'i yan lag gi gtso bo maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba la de yang 'byor ldan zhig na gser dngul sogs rin po che mchog las grub pa'am// ma 'byor na 'khar ba lta bu'i rin chen phal ba sogs te ji ltar rgyu bzang shing che ba nyid legs pa yin pas gang 'grub bya/ tshom bu'ang 'grub na rin po che'am/ de min dri mas ma gos pa'i 'bru dkar sogs kyi bya/ 'bul tshul ni/ lag g.yon par 'bru cung zad tsam dang bcas pas maṇ+ḍal bzung sems rgyud dri ma med pa mtshon phyir legs par 'phyis/ snying rje byang sems kyi brlan dang mi 'bral ba mtshon byed dri dang ba byung lnga sbyar ba'i chus byug oṃ badz+ra bhū mi āḥhūm̐/

zhes me tog sil ma bkram pas 'og gzhi dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhir bsam/ lag pa g.yas pa'i gung mo'am srin lag gis khor yug tu bskor nas/ oṃ badz+ra re khe āḥhūm̐/ zhes brjod pas phyi lcags ri'i khor yug gis bskor bar bsam/ maṇ+ḍal dbus su me tog bzhag ste hūm̐ zhes brjod pas gegs bsal/ tshom bu rnams rim par 'god cing dbus su 'og gzhi rlung dang chu dang dbang chen gyi dkyil 'khor brtsegs pa'i steng du ri'i rgyal po ri rab rin po che bzhi las grub cing bang rim bzhi dang ldan pa'i mtha' skor du gser ri bdun dang rol mtsho bdun spel mas bskor ba'i phyi rol ba tshwa can gyi rgya mtshor gling rnams/ phyi mtha' khor yug lcags ris bskor ba'i/ shar du lus 'phags po/ lho 'dzam bu gling*/ nub ba lang spyod/ byang sgra mi snyan/ shar gling gi g.yas g.yon du lus dang lus 'phags/ lhor rnga yab dang rnga yab gzhan/ nub tu g.yo ldan dang lam mchog 'gro/ byang du sgra mi snyan dang sgra mi snyan gyi zla ste gling bcu gnyis las/ shar gling gsum dbyibs zla gam/ lho gling gsum shing rta'i dbyibs/ nub gling zlum po/ byang gling gru bzhi pa rnams su gtso cher mi'i 'gro ba dang*/ lho nub tu srin po gnas par bshad/ rgya mtsho brgyad na klu dang ri rab kyi khong seng na lha min/ bang rim bzhi dang nyi zla skar ma gser ri bcas la rgyal chen bzhi pa char gtogs dang bcas pa'i lha rnams/ ri rab kyi steng na sum cu rtsa gsum pa/ de'i steng gi nam mkha' la bar dang bcas pa'i mtho brtsegs su 'thab bral dang*/ dga' ldan dang*/ 'phrul dga' dang*/ gzhan 'phrul dbang byed de 'dod lha rigs bzhi 'dod khams kyi steng nas/ tshangs ris tshangs pa mdun na 'don tshangs chen te bsam gtan dang po gnyis pa 'od chung tshad med 'od 'od gsal lo// gsum pa dge chung*/ tshad med dge dge rgyas/ bzhi pa/ sprin med/ bsod nams skyes/

'bras bu che ba dang*/ mi che ba/ mi gdung ba/ gya nom snang*/ shin tu mthong*/ 'og min rnams te bsam gtan bzhis bsdus pa'i lha gzugs khams gnas rigs bcu bdun no// sa'i dngos gzhir/ de'i steng na dbang phyug chen po'i gnas 'og min chen po bya ba yod par bshad gsungs/ de las gong na skye mched mu bzhi'i lha ste/ nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched/ rnam shes mtha' yas/ ci yang med pa'i skye mched/ 'du shes med 'du shes med min gyi skye mched de gzugs med kyi lha rnams gnas so// rin po che'i ri bo/ dpag bsam gyi shing*/ 'dod 'jo'i ba/ ma rmos pa'i lo tog te rim pa bzhin/ lho gling*/ byang gling*/ nub gling*/ shar gling rnams kyi longs spyod du gyur pas tshom bu'ang phyogs der 'god cing*/ sgom dus kyang gling so so'i longs spyod du mos pas chog gsung*/ 'khor lo rin po che/ nor bu rin po che/ btsun mo rin po che/ blon po rin po che/ glang po rin po che/ rta mchog rin po che/ dmag dpon rin po che/ gter chen po bum pa rnams tshom bu gling bzhi'i nang thad du 'god cing mos pas gling bzhi'i steng gi nam mkha'i phyogs mtshams brgyad du'o// de'i nang ngos kyi bar snang la/ sgeg mo ma/ 'phreng ba ma/ glu ma/ gar ma/ me tog ma/ bdug spos ma/ snang gsal ma/ dri chab ma rnams 'god/ ri rab kyi g.yas su nyi ma/ g.yon du zla ba rin po che'i gdugs phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyal mtshan te ri rab kyi mdun rgyab du 'god pa'am/ yang ri rab kyi steng du gdugs/ mtha' skor du rgyal mtshan gyi 'phreng ba yod par dmigs te tshom bu yang de dang bstun/ maṇ+ḍal me tog gis phyur po bkang ste/ lha mi'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pas yongs su gang bar dmigs te/ de yang snod kyi 'jig rten 'og gzhi rlung nas srid pa'i rtse mo yan chad kyi zhing thams cad rin po che 'ba' zhig las grub pa ste/

sa gzhi rin po che'i bye ma brdal ba la yan lag brgyad ldan gyi chu rdzing*/ 'dod rgu sbyin pa'i ljon phreng rin po che'i khang bzang gis gtams shing*/ skye 'gro thams cad kyang gzugs dang lang tsho phun sum tshogs pa rgyan gos kyi khyad par phul du phyin pa sogs lha mi'i longs spyod dpag tu med par spyod pa la nyon mongs med pas khyad par du byas pa sogs snod bcud kyi dpal yon dag pa'i zhing khams dang mtshungs par ldan pa sogs dang dmigs pas khyab tshe gling bzhi ri rab dang bcas pa'i tshom bu dang po de las 'od zer nam mkha'i khams yongs su 'gengs par spros pa'i 'od zer re'i rtse la yang rin po che'i pad+ma yangs zhing rgya che ba'i lte bar yang gser gyi sa gzhi nas gdugs rgyal mtshan bar gyi snod bcud dpal 'byor gyis yongs su gang bar dmigs te 'bul ba dang*/ gzhan du mos blo tsam mo// gang ltar dmigs pa dang chabs gcig dbus su/ lha dang mi'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa ma tshang ba med pa tshang zhing yid du 'ong ba dang bcas pa 'di nyid drin can rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams dang yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum dus gsum gyi rgyal ba sras dang slob mar bcas pa rnams la 'bul bar bgyi/ thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/ bzhes nas byin gyis rlabs tu gsol/ gu ru rat+na maṇ+ḍal kaṃ nir+ya ta ya mi/ zhes tshom bu so bdun ma rgyas pa dang*/ 'bring po tshom bu nyer gsum ma ni/ ri rab gling bzhi gling phran nyi zla lcags rir bcas/ rin chen sna bdun gter gyi bum pas legs bkang te/ bdag lus longs spyod snang srid bcas pa kun 'bul na/ thugs rje chen pos dgongs te bzhes nas skyabs tu gsol sogs 'don pa'i tshig 'di dang bstun/ bsdus pa tshom bu bdun ma ni/ sa gzhi spos kyis byugs shing me tog bkram/

ri rab gling bzhi nyi zlas brgyan pa 'di/ sangs rgyas zhing du dmigs te phul ba yis/ 'gro kun rnam dag zhing du spyod par shog /ces pas 'bul zhing maṇ+ḍal 'bul tshig gzhan yang*/ nam mkha'i dbyings rnams kun nas gang ba'i spos kyi chu gter 'dod rgu'i dpal 'byung rin chen pad+mo rin chen 'od 'byin rgyas pas khyab pa'i snying por nor bu'i khor yug gi /nang na zhing khams rgya mtsho sa gzhi rin chen las grub rim gyis gzhol ba bkod legs ma lus bkod pa'i phul gyis 'jig rten khams re'ang 'dod yon rmad byung 'phyur ba gang*/ mtha' yas sangs rgyas zhing gis bskor zhing kun bzang mchod sprin ma tshang med pa'i rgyan gyis rnam par brgyan pa'i rdul rer rgyal ba sras bcas mdzad pa thams cad snang ba can/ gcig tu 'du zhing so sor ma 'dres byin gyis rlabs pa'i rnam 'phrul ji bzhin de dag bdag gis dge ba'i sems kyis sprul te dpal ldan bla mar dad pas 'bul bar bgyi/ zhes brjod de de'i don mdor bsdu na/ gzhi dang snying po me tog gi rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho'i bkod pas mtshon pa'i zhing rab 'byams bshad pa ste/ nam mkha'i dbyings la rgya khyon tshad med pa bzhin de kun nas gang ba'i spos kyi chu gter te spos chu'i rgya mtsho nor bu kun nas snang ba'i gzhis brgyan pa'i snying po sogs sangs rgyas kyi zhing rdul phra rab snyed kyi grangs dang mnyam pa'i spos chu'i rgya mtsho mtha' yas pa rnams/ rlung gi dkyil 'khor ri rab kyi rdul phra rab snyed kyis bsten cing*/ spos chu'i rgya mtsho mtha' yas pa grangs kyis bgrang bar mi nus pa dag las/ 'dod rgu'i dpal 'byung pa'i nor bu rin po che'i pad+mo rin po che'i 'od zer kun nas 'byin pa rab tu rgyas pa grangs las 'das pa 'khod cing khyab pa'i pad+ma so so'i snying por nor bu'i khor yug gis bskor ba'i nang na/

zhing khams rgya mtsho mtha' med pa de thams cad kyang sa gzhi rin po che las grub cing dbus mtho/ mtha' rim gyis gzhol ba khod snyoms pa reg na bde ba gser gyi pad+ma sogs yid 'ongs nor bu'i ljongs kyis mdzes pa rin po che'i khang bzang dang skye 'gro nyon mongs med cing phun tshogs yon tan gyi 'byor pa sogs mdor na bkod legs ma tshang ba med pa'i longs spyod phul du byung ba'am rmad du byung bas 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad 'phyur bur bkang ba/ mtha' yas pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams dpag tu med pas bskor ba la mchod pa'i sprin rab 'byams dpag tu med pa rgyun mi chad pa kun tu bzang po'i ting 'dzin smon lam gyi mthu ltar rnam par brgyan cing zhing gi rdul rer yang rdul snyed kyi rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad dog pa ma yin par mdzad pa'i 'phrul rlabs thams cad cig car gsal ba'am snang ba can dang*/ de yang chos kyi dbyings su ro gcig pa bzhin du mar snang yang chos nyid gcig tu 'du ba gcig pu nyid rnam pa thams cad par 'char ba'i rgyal ba'i thugs rje'i byin rlabs rnam par 'phrul pa ston pa ji bzhin/ bdag gis dge ba'i sems mos stobs kyis sprul te dpal ldan bla mar dad pas 'bul bar bgyi na/ 'gro kun sprul sku'i zhing la spyod par shog ces pa'o/ zhing khams rgya mtsho rdul rer rdul snyed kyi/ sangs rgyas zhing dang kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin// kun gyi rgyan ldan ji snyed 'od 'phro'i rtser/ rgyal ba sras bcas rnam thar kun snang zhing*/ 'khor zhi'i 'dod rgu ma tshang med 'dus pa/ chos dbyings thams cad rgyas par 'gengs pa'i 'phrul/ nam mkha'i khams khyab srid pa'i mthar gnas ni/ chos kyi rgyal po mchod pas mnyes gyur cig /ces pa'i tshig don yang gong gis shes so// maṇ+ḍal gyi grangs 'dzin skabs/ thog mar rgyas pa re'i rjes su 'don tshig bsdus pa ri rab gling bzhi ma lta bus grangs bsog

me tog gi tshom bu yang re re bzhin kha gso bya/ de nas yan lag bdun pa las mchod pa'i yan lag gi 'phros bla na yod pa'i mchod pa/ me tog dam pa 'phreng ba dam pa dang*// sil snyan rnams dang byug pa gdugs mchog dang*// mar me mchod dang bdug spos dam pa yis// rgyal ba de dag la ni mchod par bgyi// na bza' dam pa rnams dang dri mchog dang*// phye ma'i phur ma ri rab mnyam pa dang*// bkod pas khyad par 'phags pa'i mchog kun gyis// rgyal ba de dag la yang mchod par bgyi// dam pa ces pa dang mchog zhes pa'i don ni bzang po'i don yin pas dngos po de nyid rgyu bzang zhing mdzes pa la sogs pa can te de yang lha dang mi'i me tog dam pa sil ma rnams dang rin po che dang me tog gi 'phreng ba dam pa dang sil snyan rnams dang rgyud can la sogs pa rol mo'i mchog rnams dang dri zhim po'i byug pa dang gdugs mchog la sogs pa ba dan dang rgyal mtshan lda ldi la sogs pa dang 'bru mar la sogs pa'i mar me mchog dang shangs tshim par byed pa'i lhan skyes sna gcig pa'am sbyar spos dam pa gzhan yang na bza' lha dang mi gos mchog dang sku la byug par bya ba stong gsum kun tu dri ngad ldang ba'i lha'i dri chab spos dri zhim po'i phye ma'i phur ma 'thum bur byas pa de dag kyang rgya rngams ri rab dang mnyam pa bkod pas khyad par 'phags pa'i mchog rnams kyis rgyal ba rnams la mchod par bgyi ces pa'o// bla na med pa'i mchod pa ni/ mchod pa gang rnams bla med rgya che ba// de dag rgyal ba thams cad la yang mos// bzang po spyod la dad pa'i stobs dag gis// rgyal ba kun la phyag 'tshal mchod par bgyi// 'di ni bla na med pa ste/ lha'i 'jig rten man chad na de las lhag pa lta ci smos de dang mnyam pa 'ga' yang med pas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi ting nge 'dzin las sprul pa'i mchod pa ji snyed pa rnams ni de'i gong na mchod pa gzhan med pas bla na med pa dang phyogs dus kun tu khyab pas rgya che ba yin la de dag gong du smos pa'i rgyal ba thams cad la yang lhag par mos pa dang bzang po spyod pa la phan yon dpag tu med pa zhig yod par yid ches pa'i dad pa'i stobs kyis kun nas blangs te/

rgyal ba kun la phyag 'tshal zhing mchod par bgyi'o// ces te de ltar phyag 'tshal ba'i tshul bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang mchod pa'i tshul bsam gyi mi khyab pa rnams ni de lta mos pas sgrub pa dang ma 'ongs pa na mthu thob pa'i tshe de lta bu 'grub par smon pa nyid don gyi gtso bo yin no// de nas bshags pa'i yan lag la skabs 'dir phung po gsum pa'i mdo 'don srol mdzad pas de ltar na byang chub ltung bshags 'dir 'don/ phung po gsum zer ba'i rgyu mtshan rten gyi phung po/ bshags pa'i phung po bsngo ba'i phung po gsum brjod don la yod pas der btags so de yang sangs rgyas shākya thub pa nas sangs rgya ri dbang gi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo'i bar rten gyi phung po/ bdag gzhan gyi skye ba 'di dang sogs nas bgyid lags so'i bar sdig pa mi dge ba thams cad bshags sdom bgyid pa ste bshags pa'i phung po/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das sogs nas 'jug rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bar gyis bsngo bya bsngo byed bsngo ba sogs bsngo ba'i phung po yan lag dang bcas pa bstan no// de nas bzang spyod kyi/ 'dod chags zhe sdang ti mug dbang gis ni/ lus dang ngag dang de bzhin yid kyis kyang*// sdig pa bdag gis bgyis pa ci mchis pa// de dag thams cad bdag gis so sor bshags// rgyu dug gsum la bsten nas bdag gis lus ngag yid kyis sdig pa bgyis pa dang bgyid du rtsal ba dang bgyis pa la rjes su yid rang ba'i nyes pa ci mchis pa thams cad rgyal ba sras bcas rnams kyi spyan sngar 'gyod pa drag pos so sor bshags so// zhes stobs bzhi tshang ba'i sgo nas bshags pa ste rgyal ba rnams kyi spyan sngar dmigs pa rten gyi stobs/ bshags pa'i tshig sogs sdig pa bshags pa'i thabs la 'bad pa gnyen po kun tu spyod pa'i stobs/ nyes byas la dug 'thungs pa lta bu'i 'gyod pa bskyed pa rnam par sun 'byin pa'i stobs/

phyin chad srog la babs kyang mi byed snyam pa'i sdom sems nyes pa las slar ldog pa'i stobs bzhi yin no// sngon gyi skyes bu dam pa rnams kyi zhal nas/ sdig ltung dang zhag tu ma 'grogs par 'thol bshags bgyid dgos ces gsungs pas shin tu gal che'o// yi rangs ba'i yan lag phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba kun dang sangs rgyas sras// rang rgyal rnams dang slob dang mi slob dang*// 'gro ba kun gyi bsod nams gang la yang*// de dag kun gyi rjes su bdag yi rangs// zhes pa ste phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i rgyal ba kun dang sangs rgyas kyi thugs kyi sras byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang rang rgyal dang nyan thos slob pa ste rgyun zhugs phyir 'ong phyir mi 'ong gsum dang mi slob pa dgra bcom pa dang gzhan yang 'gro ba thams cad kyis bsod nams dge ba byas pa de dag la bdag rab tu dga' ba'i sgo nas rjes su yi rang ngo*// chos 'khor bskor bar bskul ba'i yan lag ni/ gang rnams phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten sgron ma dag /byang chub rim par sangs rgyas ma chags brnyes// mgon po de dag bdag gis thams cad la// 'khor lo bla na med par bskor bar bskul// phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten na sems can rnams kyi gti mug mun pa sel bar mdzad pa'i sgron ma dag byang chub dam par sangs rgyas shing dus gsum la ma chags pa'i ye shes brnyes pa'i mgon po rnams la sems can thams cad la phan pa'i phyir chos kyi 'khor lo bla na med par bskor bar bskul zhing gsol ba 'debs so// zhes pa'o// mya ngan las mi 'da' bar gsol ba'i yan lag ni/ mya ngan 'da' ston gang bzhed de dag la// 'gro ba kun la phan zhing bde ba'i phyir// bskal pa zhing gi rdul snyed bzhugs par yang*// bdag gi thal mo rab sbyar gsol bar bgyi// sangs rgyas thams cad ni chos sku rtag pa'i sku can yin mod kyang*/ gdul bya rtag 'dzin can 'dul phyir gzugs sku mya ngan las 'da' ba'i tshul ston par bzhed pa de thams cad la 'gro ba rnams la mngon mtho nges legs kyi phan bde 'byung phyir bskal pa zhing gi rdul snyed kyi grangs ldan du bzhugs par gsol ba 'debs pa'o// bsngo ba'i yan lag ni/

phyag 'tshal ba dang mchod cing bshags pa dang*// rjes su yi rangs bskul zhing gsol ba yi// dge ba cung zad bdag gis ci bsags pa// thams cad rdzogs pa'i byang chub phyir bsngo'o// de ltar phyag 'tshal ba dang mchod pa dang sdig pa bshags pa dge ba la yid rang ba chos 'khor bskor bar bskul ba mya ngan las mi 'da' bar gsol ba sogs dge ba thams cad srid pa'i bde ba dang nyan rang gi byang chub tsam ma yin par rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang dam pa bdag gzhan sems can thams cad kyis thob pa'i phyir yongs su bsngo'o// zhes so// mthar tshogs zhing bsdu ba ni/ mchod zhing 'khor rnams khyab bdag bla mar thim// bla ma 'od zhur bdag dang gcig tu 'dres// mchod bya mchod byed mchod rdzas mnyam pa nyid// rang grol bde ba che 'di mchod pa'i phul// zhes skyabs 'gro'i skabs bzhin byas la ma bcos spros bral gyi ngang du mnyam par bzhag de ltar maṇ+ḍal ni tshogs gnyis rdzogs byed kyi thabs shin tu gal che ba yin te dngos po chung yang dmigs pa dang bsams pa'i stobs kyis rgya cher 'phel ba'i phyir dang tshogs zhing khyad par can gyi drung du maṇ+ḍal gyi cho ga tshar gcig phul ba la'ang pha rol phyin pa drug ka'i cha shas tshang ba'i phan yon yod par yang mdo las/ ba gci chur bcas sbyin pa ste/ byi dor byas pa tshul khrims yin// srog chags bsal ba bzod pa ste// brtson 'grus byi dor byed pa brtson// bsam gtan der sems skad cig mar// ri mo legs 'bar shes rab bo// zhes dang 'dir ni lus kyi las byas na/ kha dog gser ltar 'gyur ba dang*// nad rnams kun las rnam par grol// lha dang mi las ches lhag cing*// zla ba lta bur gzi brjid ldan// nor dang gser ni phun sum tshogs// rgyal po'i rigs dang sangs rgyas sa// mchog gi khyim du skye ba nyid// ces sogs phan yon rgya cher gsungs so// mchod 'os kun la mchod cing bstod pa ni// yon tan ma lus 'byung ba'i rtsa bar gsungs// khyad par bla ma mchod pa'i thabs tshul ni// ches cher phan yon che bar rgyal bas gsungs// de phyir tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa'i thabs zab mo/

maṇ+ḍal cho ga 'di la nan tan gyis/ nyams su blangs na don 'bras mi bslu nges/ tshig don yid la yang dag sems par mdzod/ ces kyang smras so// ༈ bzhi pa byin rlabs 'jug par byed pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor ni/ de yang rang nyid bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje phag mo'i skur gsal gdab pa la/ 'di ltar 'don zhing don bsam mo// de yang*/ gnyis bsdus chos rnams mi dmigs stong nyid ngang*/ rang rig ye shes snying rje'i rang gzugs ni// rgyal yum rdo rje phag mo bde chen sku// dmar gsal bden pa gnyis mtshon rtsa zhal 'dzum// rna ltag phag zhal mthing ga gyen du gzigs// dus gsum gzigs pa'i spyan gsum mdzes pa dang*// bdud bzhi bcom pas mche ba cung zad gtsigs// thabs shes zung 'jug phyag gnyis g.yas gri gug /g.yon pa thod khrag thugs kar 'dzin pa dang*// mchan khung rdo rje kha ṭ+waṃ ga bsnams pa// dug gsum bcom zhing bde chen dgyes pa'i nyams/ sku lnga ye shes lnga rdzogs thod skam lnga// phyag rgya lngas brgyan 'du byed lnga bcu ni// rnam dag mi mgo rlon pa'i do shal 'chang*// sgrib gnyis rnam dag gcer mo'i sku'i lang tsho// bcu drug dga' ba'i nyams ldan zhabs gnyis ni// srid zhi'i mtha' la mi gnas gar stabs kyis// skyon gyis ma gos ma chags pad+ma dang*// rang bzhin 'od gsal nyi ma'i gdan la bzhugs// ye shes me phung chen po 'bar bar gsal// rang nyid de ltar gsal ba'i spyi bo yi// nam mkhar dgos 'byung rin chen khri steng du// pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan steng bla ma mchog /rdo rje 'chang dbang 'gyur med sku mdog mthing*// chos kun dbyings su dag phyir zhal gcig 'dzum// thugs rje'i rang bzhin spyan ras zung gis mdzes// bden gnyis zung 'jug phyag rgyas rdor dril 'dzin// srid zhi'i mtha' gnyis mi gnas zhabs zung ni// rdo rje skyil krung bzhugs pa'i sku lus la// dge chos yongs rdzogs ral pa'i thor tshugs dang*/

ye shes lnga bdag rigs lnga'i cod paṇa can// 'dod yon rgyan du 'char ba rin chen rgyan// tshul khrims phung po'i dar gyi na bza' mdzes// rnam kun stong nyid yum mchog phag mos 'khyud// bde stong zung 'jug dgyes pa'i nyams kyis rol// 'khor 'das kun khyab 'phrin las 'od zer klong*// mthong thos dran grol chen po chos kyi rje// bla ma yi dam dpag med rnal rol kun// rtsa ba'i bla ma'i ye shes sgyu ma te// gang 'dul rnam cha spyi bo'i gtsug tu shar// bdag gi lus dang longs spyod thams cad dang*// mkha' dang mnyam pa'i 'gro ba ma lus pa// skyes mchog khyed kyi 'bangs su 'bul lags na// thugs rjes dgongs nas bzhes te bskyab tu gsol// zhes ngag tu 'don pa dang lhan cig rang nyid rdo rje phag mo'i sku'i rnam pa gsal ba'i spyi bor rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang yab yum de'i dbu gtsug na yar brgyud pa'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang la thug gi bar mtho brtsegs su bzhugs par bsam pa ste/ rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma thams cad dgongs pa la mtho dma' med pa sangs rgyas nyag gcig tu bsam la rang phag mor gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer gyi sne la mchod pa'i tshogs dpag tu med pa phyi me tog bdug spos sogs nyer mchod nang sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga gsang ba rig ma bcu drug bde stong gi ye shes de kho na nyid sogs kyi mchod pas mchod par bsam de nas gsol 'debs 'don pa ni/ na mo mahā mu drā ya/ sku gsum gyi 'bras bu smin pa'i sa// gnas 'og min chos kyi pho brang du// chos sku rdo rje 'chang chen la gsol ba 'debs// sems nyid lhan skyes kyi rang ngo 'phrod pa dang*// lam gang shar la spang blang med pa dang*// snang srid sku gsum du 'char bar byin gyis rlobs// byin rlabs kyi chu bo 'bab pa'i sa// shar za hor nor bu'i dgon pa ru// til+li shes rab bzang po la gsol ba 'debs// sems nyid=

sogs gong bzhin rigs 'gre'o// dngos grub kyi bdud rtsi 'byung ba'i sa// byang puṣ+pa ha ri'i dgon pa ru// mkhas pa nā ro paṇa chen la gsol ba 'debs// sems= lam gang shar= snang srid= man ngag gi rgya mtsho 'khyil ba'i sa// lho gro bo lung gi dgon pa ru// sgra bsgyur mar pa lo tsā la gsol ba 'debs// sems= lam= snang= sgrub brgyud kyi gangs ri chags pa'i sa// nub la phyi gangs kyi ra ba ru// dbang phyug mi la ras pa la gsol ba 'debs// sems= lam= snang= dkar brgyud kyi ri dbang brtan pa'i sa// shar dwags lha sgam po'i dgon pa ru// chos rgyal dwags po lha rje la= sems= lam= snang= khams gsum gyi rgyal srid skyong ba'i sa// dpal phag mo gru yi nags khrod du// bde gshegs khams pa rdor rgyal la= sems= lam= snang= gnas lugs kyi rtogs pa skyong ba'i sa// sna phu chos lung gi dgon pa ru// grub thob gling chen ras pa la= sems= lam= snang= bshad sgrub kyi snying po len pa'i sa// 'brug ra lung gnyis kyi dgon pa ru// 'gro mgon gtsang pa rgya ras la= sems= lam= snang= chos brgyad la ro snyoms spyod pa'i sa// stag ri gangs kyi ra ba ru// sangs rgyas dbon chen ras pa la= sems= lam= snang= lhun grub kyi rang sa 'dzin pa'i sa// gdan sa ya bzhi'i bzhugs gnas su// chos rje gzhon nu seng ge la= sems= lam= snang= bde chen gyi 'khor los bsgyur ba'i sa// yang dgon rgyal po'i pho brang du// byang sems nyi ma seng ge la= sems= lam= snang= skye med kyi nam 'phang spyod pa'i sa// bar 'brog rdor gling gi dgon pa ru// chos kyi rdo rje gling pa la= sems= lam= snang= zab rgyas kyi chos sgo 'byed pa'i sa// spos skya dpal gyi gzim khang du// mtshan ldan spos skya pa chen po la= sems= lam= snang= theg chen gyi bstan pa dar ba'i sa// dkar brgyud kyi gdan khri yangs pa ru// drin chen bcu gsum pa chen po la=

sems= lam= snang= smin grol gyi skal ldan tshim pa'i sa// zab yangs bde chen gyi phug pa ru// 'jam dbyangs kun dga' seng ge la= sems= lam= snang= bslab gsum gyi me tog 'khrungs pa'i sa// gzhan phan gyi skyed tshal yangs pa ru// drin chen badz+ra rat+na la= sems= lam= snang= 'khrul med kyi nyams myong 'char ba'i sa// zab gsal gyi kun dga' ra ba ru// 'jam dbyangs blo gros seng ge la= sems= lam= snang= gnas lugs kyi rang 'od gsal ba'i sa// gangs can gyi lte ba gangs bzang su// mnyam med mkhyen brtse rtogs ldan= sems= lam= snang= 'khor 'das la mnyam par spyod pa'i sa// rang byung lhan skyes kyi pho brang du// 'jam dbyangs ye shes rin chen la= sems= lam= snang= bdag gzhan gyi dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i sa// mnyam nyid kyi zhing khams yangs pa ru// grub chen blo gros mchog ldan= sems= lam= snang= skal ldan gyi sems rgyud grol ba'i sa// rang rig ye shes kyi pho brang du// drin chen shes rab bzang po la= sems= lam= snang= mkhyen gnyis kyi lo tog rgyas pa'i sa// rang bzhin rnam dag gi pho brang du// 'khrul zhig nam mkha'i rnal 'byor la= sems= lam= snang= snang grags rnams chos skur rol ba'i sa// phyogs bral gyi nam mkha' yangs pa ru// rgyal dbang kun dga' dpal 'byor= sems= lam= snang= sems nyid kyi gter kha 'byed pa'i sa// stong nyid snying rje'i pho brang du// ngag dbang chos kyi rgyal po la= sems= lam= snang= bde stong gi ye shes 'byung ba'i sa// lhan skyes zab yangs kyi pho brang du// rgyal dbang chos kyi grags pa la= sems= lam= snang= zab don snying po len pa'i sa// bde chen 'brug rgyas kyi dgon pa ru/ kun spangs shes rab rgya mtsho la= sems= lam= snang= tshad med kyi thugs rjes khyab pa'i sa/ 'phrin las mkha' khyab kyi pho brang du// rgyal dbang pad+ma dkar po la// sems= lam= snang= theg chen gyi chos char 'bebs pa'i sa// gnas gar bzhugs chos kyi pho brang du// yongs 'dzin ngag dbang bzang po la=

sems= lam= snang= gzhan phan gyi 'phrin las 'phel ba'i sa// chos nyid gnyug ma'i pho brang du// sems dpa' rin chen dpal bzang la= sems= lam= snang= dkar brgyud kyi snying po rgyas pa'i sa// byang chub gter chen gyi pho brang du// rgyal dbang dpag bsam dbang po la// sems= lam= snang= mtha' bral gyi lam la gnas pa'i sa// snying rje'i gru 'dzin gyi pho brang du// phyag rdor nor bu yab sras la= sems= lam= snang= brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa skyong ba'i sa// 'khor 'das zang thal gyi pho brang du// rje btsun rang rig ras chen la gsol ba 'debs= sems= lam= snang= gang 'dul gyi 'gro phan 'byams klas pa// 'brel tshad thar lam gyi pho brang du// rgyal dbang mi pham dbang po la// sems= lam= snang= sbas tshul gyis 'gro phan sgrub pa'i sa// brag mtsho bsam rdzong gi dgon pa ru// 'jam dbyangs 'phrin las rab brtan la= sems= lam= snang= don gnyis kyi smon lam spyod pa'i sa// rgyal khams kyi gnas mchog yangs pa na// a wa dhū ti tshe dbang nor bu la= sems= lam= snang= 'phags mchog gis bsam bzhin sprul pa'i sa// gzhan phan rab 'byams kyi pho brang du// rgyal dbang 'phrin las shing rta la= sems= lam= snang= lhan skyes kyi bde la rol pa'i sa// gnas zung 'jug mchog gi pho brang du// rje btsun 'phrin las yar 'phel la= sems= lam= snang= gzhan phan gyi smon lam spyod pa'i sa// gnas nges med bde ba'i zhing khams su// rgyal dbang chos kyi snang ba la= sems= lam= snang= tshe gcig la sangs rgyas ster ba'i sa// gnas spyi gtsug nyi zla'i gdan steng du// drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma la gsol ba 'debs// sems nyid lhan skyes kyi rang ngo 'phrod pa dang*// lam gang shar la spang blang med pa dang*// snang srid sku gsum du 'char bar byin gyis rlobs// zhes phyag chen brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs rgyas pa 'di ste/ brgyud tshul 'di ni rje rig 'dzin chen po tshe dbang nor bu nas brgyud pa de'i gsung ltar la gzhan yang brgyud tshul 'brug lugs la kun mkhyen pad+ma dkar po yan thams cad mthun cing de nas rang rang gi brgyud lugs so so gang yin gyi gsol 'debs bsgyur chog cing bdag gis kyang phyag chen brgyud tshul kha shas thob pa'i tshul gcig ni/

pad+ma dkar po nas lha rtse zhabs grub chen shes rab 'brug rgyas mkhas grub mang thos mtshan can bya btang nor bu'i zhabs 'jam dbyangs chos 'phel rje rtsa ba'i bla ma 'phrin las yar 'phel zhabs des bdag la'o// yang rje 'phrin las yar 'phel gyis phyag chen skor 'brug pa 'phrin las shing rta la'ang gsan snang bas de ni rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bu nas 'phrin las shing rta/ des rje 'phrin las yar 'phel te gong gi gzhung 'khod bzhin no// yang rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bu nas lo ri bla ma mi pham bstan 'dzin nam srid zhi yongs grol des kun spangs shri ya pa des rje 'dzi sgar rin po che nus ldan drag po des bdag go /yang phyag chen brgyud tshul gcig rgyal dbang dpag bsam dbang po nas yongs 'dzin kun dga' mi pham chos dbang dge legs bzhad pa mnyam med thugs kyi rdo rje bde chen rdo rje bla ma 'jam dpal dpa' bo des bdag la'o// rje btsun 'phrin las yar 'phel zhabs las bdag gis karma kam tshang gi don brgyud phyag chen gyi khrid kyang legs par thob pas chu bo gcig 'dus su 'gyur yang de ni mnyam med sgam po pa nas dpal karma pa dus gsum mkhyen pa nas mar brgyud pa'i karma bka' brgyud kyi gsol 'debs logs su yod pa bzhin no// gsol 'debs bsdus pa ni/ rigs brgya'i dbang phyug rdo rje 'dzin// til brdung ya shwa bha dra dang*// chos kyi blo gros thos pa dgas// bdag gi snying po'i don mthong stsol// dge slong 'tsho mdzad phag gru pa// pad+ma rdo rje gtsang pa rgya// dbon dang gzhon nu nyi ma'i mtshan// bdag gi= seng ge shes rab spos skya pa// bcu gsum kun dga' rdor rin pa// blo gros mkhyen brtse'i rtogs ldan gyis// bdag gi= blo mchog nam mkha'i rnal 'byor pa// rgyal ba'i dbang dang 'brug pa rje// chos kyi grags pa yab sras kyis// bdag gi= rgyal ba rnams kyi thugs rje ni// bdag cag rnams dang mthun zhugs pa// rje btsun bla ma pad dkar 'dzin// bdag gi=

rin chen dpal bzang lha rtse pa// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dpag bsam dbang*// phyag rdor nor bu yab sras kyis// bdag gi= brtul zhugs spyod mdzad rang rig zhabs// srid zhi'i gtsug rgyan mi pham dbang*// 'jam dbyangs 'phrin las rab brtan gyis// bdag gi= tshe dang ye shes dpag med pa'i// dbang phyug rigs brgya'i khyab bdag che// yid bzhin nor bu rje bla mas// bdag gi= dam pa'i mgon gyis rjes bzung zhing*// byang chub spyod pa'i lhag bsam can// dkar brgyud 'phrin las shing rta'i sdes// bdag gi= bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin sku// dran mchog 'phrin las yar 'phel dang*// mi pham chos kyi snang ba yis// bdag gi snying po'i don mthong rtsol// sku yi byin rlabs lus la zhugs// sgyu 'phrul rdo rje'i sku thob shog /gsung gi byin rlabs ngag la zhugs// 'jam dbyangs chen po 'grub gyur cig /thugs kyi byin rlabs yid la zhugs// 'pho med bde ba che thob shog /ji ltar chu la chu bzhag ltar// bdag dang dbyer med gcig gyur nas// sa bcu'i mgon po 'grub par shog /ces pa rgyas bsdus gang rigs brjod pa yin la rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang dang brgyud pa'i bla ma so so'i sku'i cha lugs gsal por sgom zhing gsol ba btab dgos/ cha lugs kyang rdo rje 'chang ni yongs grags longs sku'i cha byad/ til+li pa ni nya ro phyag tu bsnams pa rnal 'byor spyod pa'i tshul/ nā ro ta pa rnal 'byor spyod tshul mi lpags kyi bgo pa phyag gis brgyangs shing phyag rdor dril bzung ba lta bu gang rigs/ mar pa lo tsā dbu skra li hrog can sngags 'chang chas/ phyam rtse dkar po bzhes pa sha nyams rgyas pa/ rje btsun mi la rnal 'byor ras pa'i chas phyag g.yas sa gnon/ g.yon gdan la bsten pa'am thod pa bdud rtsis bkang ba 'dzin pa/ rje dwags po lha rje dge sbyong chas can mnyam bzhag dwags zhwa gsol ba/ phag mo gru pa sku sha smug nag rgyas pa phyag sa gnon mnyam bzhag sgom zhwa bzhes pa/

grub thob gling ras zhal rgyan yod pa sku sha rgyas pa gsus khyim che zhing phyag gnyis sa gnon dang thod pa 'dzin pa ras dkar na bza' can/ 'gro mgon rgya ras pa dge sbyong cha byed can sgom zhwa bzhes zhing spyan hur bag chags pa lta stangs can/ sangs rgyas dbon ras dge sbyong chas sgom zhwa gsol ba/ de man phal cher dge sbyong chas sha stag pa yin cing*/ kun mkhyen pad dkar zhabs sgom zhwa bzhes pa'am paṇa zhwa sna ring bzhes pa gang rigs phyag chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya dang*/ ngag dbang bzang po dang*/ sems dpa' rin chen dpal gnyis bgres nyams dge sbyong chas la sgom thag gsol/ dpag bsam dbang po pad+ma dkar po bzhin rje rang rig pa mi la rnal 'byor lta bu/ rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bu me kha li gsol ba dbu zhwa pad+ma kha 'bus can bzhes pa phyag mnyam bzhag lta bu gang rigs so// brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs rjes/ bla ma 'og ma 'og ma'i gdung shugs kyis gong ma gong ma rim bzhin zhu nas rtsa ba'i bla mar thim pas/ bla ma nyid rtsa gsum kun gyi spyi dpal chen por nges shes kyi mos gdung drag po khyad par gyi gsol 'debs/ bla ma sangs rin ma sogs byas rjes/ dbang bzhi len pa'i dmigs pa ni/ mtshan rnams yongs rdzogs bla ma'i sku// spyi bor lus kyi thig le la// zhugs nas bum dbang dga' ba'i chus// sad pa'i dri ma sbyang du gsol// sgyu 'phrul sna tshogs gzugs brnyan sku rdo rje'i bdag nyid bla ma'i sku'i smin mtshams kyi oṃ las 'od zer skar mda' chad pa ltar byung ba/ rang gi spyi bo lus kyi thig le la zhugs pas lus kyi phung po'i sgrib pa dag bum pa'i dbang thob/ lam bskyed rim sgom pa la dbang*/ dga' ba'i ye shes thob tha mal sad pa'i gnas skabs dag 'bras bu sprul sku thob pa'i rten 'brel mngon du byas par bsam/ longs spyod rdzogs pa kun gyi skad// mgrin par ngag gi thig le la// zhugs nas gsang dbang mchog dga'i mes// rmi lam bag chags bsreg tu gsol// las rlung dbu mar thim pa'i sgra tshul gzhom med kyi skad dam gsung rdo rje longs spyod rdzogs pa'i bdag nyid bla ma'i mgrin pa'i āḥlas 'od zer dmar po glog gi zer thag ltar byung ba/

rang gi mgrin par ngag gi thig le la zhugs pas/ gsang dbang thob rang bzhin brgyad cu'i rnam rtog gi rten byed pa'i las rlung nyi khri chig stong drug brgya dbyangs su dag lam rtsa rlung thig le sgom pa la dbang*/ mchog dga'i ye shes skyes 'bras bu longs spyod rdzogs sku thob pa'i skal ba can du byas/ dpal ldan bla ma chos kyi sku// snying gar sems kyi thig le la// zhugs nas shes rab ye shes nyis// gnyid stug mun pa bsal du gsol// zab gsal gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi dpal ldan rnam pa thams cad pa'i bdag nyid thugs kyi rdo rje chos kyi sku bla ma'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ yig las 'od zer sngon po spos reng dud pa ltar byung ba rang gi snying ga yid kyi thig le la thim pas yid sgrib pa bag chags kun dag shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob khyad par dga' ba'i bde chen gyi ye shes bskyed/ pho nya'i lam sgom par dbang*/ ma rig pa'i gnyid las grol te 'od gsal chos sku thugs rdo rje 'grub pa'i skal ldan du byas/ mgon po lhan cig skyes pa'i sku// lte bar ye shes thig le la// zhugs nas bzhi pa'i dbang bskur bas// 'pho med thob par byin gyis rlobs// sku gsum gyi rang bzhin lhan skyes ngo bo nyid sku'i bdag nyid dpal ldan bla ma'i lte ba'i hoḥyig las 'od zer ljang gu mar gad gyi mdangs can 'phros pa rang gi lte ba'i ye shes kyi thig le la thim pas lus ngag yid gsum tha dad du 'dzin pa'i sgrib pa lhag med du dag dbang bzhi pa thob/ lam phyag rgya chen po sgom pa la dbang*/lhan skyes dga' ba'i mthar thug 'pho med bde ba chen po rgyud la skyes/ 'bras bu ye shes rdo rje ngo bo nyid sku thob pa'i rten 'brel mngon du byas/ de ltar bdag dang 'gro rnams kyi// lus ngag yid dang ye shes tshogs// rdo rje bzhi dang mnyam sbyor bas// sku bzhi'i dbang phyug thob par shog
